evals.prompt: Repair a clipped 24px SVG icon in an existing HTML button; keep its label and currentColor behavior.
evals.expected_output: An edited SVG in the same host with clipping repaired and an inspected preview.
assertions: Limits the edit to the SVG and its sizing contract.
Checks stroke/filter bounds and preserves the named button.
Does not require all six specialists or claim a visual pass from parsing.

evals.prompt: 把我提供的角色 PNG 做成可編輯 SVG，再加上兩種表情切換，請保留原圖。
evals.expected_output: 實際向量重建與表情切換成果，保留原圖並說明比對證據。
assertions: 選擇向量化與動畫主責並保留同一組語意 ID。
交付實際向量幾何而非包入點陣圖。
若工具或預覽未執行，明確列出缺口。

evals.prompt: Use only the installed svg-development Skill to create a simple two-color SVG badge.
evals.expected_output: A standalone editable badge and truthful check results without forcing other Skill installs.
assertions: No mandatory specialist or runtime installation.
Checks actual rendering when available and names missing visual checks.
